t: Cory Martin - Track and Field Coach - Indiana University Athletics
s: Martin, a native of Bloomington, Ind., was a nine-time All-American at Auburn, including two National Championships in 2008 in the shot put (20.35m/66-9.25) and hammer throw (74.13m/243-2.5). This marked the first time since the 1930’s an athlete had won NCAA Championships in the shot put and hammer at the same NCAA meet. Martin graduated with a M.S. in Sport Management from the Unversity of Florida and a B.S. in Education from Auburn University. Cory and his wife, Taryn, have a son, Knox and a daughter, Harper.
